key_path: squareup.com/signup?v=developers: name, email, password, country, accept terms, business name, application name
Developer Console opens the new app automatically
toggle Sandbox, click 'Show' on Sandbox access token, copy
production payments: activate account at squareup.com/activation (identity/business + bank)

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.squareup.com advertises registration_endpoint /register, granular Square scopes (CUSTOMERS_READ, ITEMS_READ ...) in protected-resource metadata
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: no - personal tokens from Developer Console; OAuth API for third-party sellers
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: partial - OAuth tokens are scoped; personal access tokens are full access
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - Sandbox token per application, test seller accounts
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - developer account and sandbox free

mcp.type: product MCP covering the full Square API (generic API-call tools)

remote.auth: OAuth with DCR and granular scopes; production only

mcp.local: npx square-mcp-server start with ACCESS_TOKEN + SANDBOX=true (sandbox only via local)

score_justification: Short signup to a sandbox token and a scoped OAuth-DCR remote MCP, but the remote MCP can't reach Sandbox and there's no CLI/device login.
best_practice: Granular OAuth scopes published in the MCP protected-resource metadata, so the user approves only what the agent needs.
biggest_gap: Remote MCP is production-only; agents testing safely must fall back to a local server with a full-access token.
